artifacts.summary: 5-phase implementation plan for IPL conservative over ConjImpBot with NonemptyLowerSet HA construction

memory_candidates.content: For conservative extension proofs in the conj-imp-bot fragment: the LowerSet.Iic embedding does NOT preserve bot (LowerSet.Iic bot = {bot} vs bot : LowerSet B = empty). Use NonemptyLowerSet B = {S : LowerSet B // bot in S} as a subtype. This IS a HeytingAlgebra where Iic preserves all four operations {inf, top, himp, bot}. The construction generalizes: any pointed BSL embeds bot-preservingly into NonemptyLowerSet(B).
